scope: activation stage only; no QMM, model, checkpoint, or production geometry
buffers: contiguous float32 gate/up input and output buffers sized exactly M*H
inputs: same deterministic synthetic fixture declaration channels, separately generated for each candidate
report: median, p05, p95, min, max, standard deviation, and per-trial samples
selection: only among numerically qualified candidates; materially faster wins; effective tie prefers simpler/native; other qualified candidate retained as fallback
